title: Adidas aura
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local function applyFullAdidasAura()
    local Animate = Character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if not Animate then return end
    
    
    local ids = {
        idle = "110211186840347",
        walk = "83842218823011",
        run = "118320322718866",
        jump = "109996626521204",
        fall = "112184433112233",
        swim = "99129837931148",
        swimidle = "114191137265065",
        climb = "108422112344567"
    }

    Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    task.wait(0.3)
    
    pcall(function()
        
        for _, v in pairs(Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do v:Stop(0) end
        
       
        if Animate:FindFirstChild("idle") then
            Animate.idle.Animation1.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.idle
            Animate.idle.Animation2.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.idle
        end
        Animate.walk.WalkAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.walk
        Animate.run.RunAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.run
        Animate.jump.JumpAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.jump
        Animate.fall.FallAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.fall
        
        if Animate:FindFirstChild("swim") then
            Animate.swim.Swim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.swim
            Animate.swimidle.SwimIdle.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.swimidle
        end
        
        if Animate:FindFirstChild("climb") then
            Animate.climb.ClimbAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. ids.climb
        end

        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Adidas Aura FULL",
            Text = "Все анимации, включая Fall и Swim, обновлены!",
            Duration = 5
        })
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
end

applyFullAdidasAura()

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    Character = newChar
    Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    task.wait(1)
    applyFullAdidasAura()
end)
